name: Toma Snana
personality: uneasy when ritual meaning is questioned
loyal to Nara without much independent skepticism
daily_routine: assisting Nara with sunrise purification rites
resealing the Bath's brickwork with bitumen as needed
memorizing the full seasonal chant cycle
guiding villagers through minor purification requests
maintaining the steps and drains of the Bath complex

goals.public_goal: Perform every rite exactly as Nara has taught, without error
goals.hidden_goal: Earn Nara's full confidence that he can preserve the rites correctly after her death
goals.deep_goal: Decide what to do if Nara's suspicion about the chants' practical origin turns out to be true

beliefs: Precision honors the ancestors who first performed these rites
Nara sees deeper meanings in the chants than he does, and he trusts her judgment
Questioning ritual meaning too openly risks losing the ritual itself
The Bath's waters have never once run dry, even through the Turning, which itself feels significant
He is not yet ready to lead the rites alone
